body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News & Press Release> Toshiba is enhancing its lineup with the introduction of three new LCD televisions featuring slot loading DVD players.

Toshiba’s ‘22LV505’ features a 22-inch widescreen LCD screen with 1680 x 1050 resolution and a 1000:1 contrast ratio. Plus, it offers a fast response speed of 5ms, making action scenes virtually pop off the screen.

The HDMI™ and PC inputs, along with a very thin chassis depth of just 2.95-inch, allow consumers to easily integrate this set into their home offices or kitchens. Additionally, the 22LV505 supports WMA, MP3, JPEG and DIVX playback to conveniently support any owner’s favorite media.
The 22LV505 is available for 599.99(USD) in April 2008.
